scientific_integrity: The spectral proof is analytic and applies to any existing finite projective plane; finite numerical checks are ancillary, and no independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Only projective-plane point–line shortest-path metrics are classified.
The general supercritical bandwidth set is given by exact inequalities, not a component census.
Literature comparison is bounded; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp negative type and covariance thresholds for projective-plane incidence metrics
